tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsol 'debs yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so// swasti/ bslu med bla ma dkon mchog rnam gsum dang / /sa skya'i bla chen rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /rtse gcig mos gus gdung bas gsol 'debs kyi/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la 'jug par shog /khyad par bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog rdo rje 'chang chen 'jam dbyangs mi yi gzugs/ /rje btsun dam pa kun dga' bkra shis la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rje byin rlabs dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mthus/ /'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad nyer zhi nas/ /'di phyi'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ces pa'i gsol 'debs 'di dge slong mkhyen rab dar rgyas dang / slob dpon klu skyes kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis kyis sbyar ba dge /maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /bshags pa smon lam dang bcas pa'i yig chung bzhugs// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa brgyud par bcas rnams dang / /rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad dang / /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems sogs/ /thams cad bdag la brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas/ /da lta'i bar du lus ngag yid gsum gyis/ /sdig pa mi dge'i las rnams ci bgyis pa/ /de dag thams cad mthol zhing bshags par bgyi/ /mtshams med lnga dang de dang nye ba lnga/ /mi dge bcu spyad so thar sdom pa dang / /byang chub sems bskyed gsang sngags dam tshig dang / 'gal bar gyur pa thams cad mthol lo bshags/ /khyad par du yang bla ma dam pa la/ /ma gus bsrung ba'i dam tshig las 'das pa/ /mi 'bral ba dang za ba'i dam tshig rnams/ /ma brten bsnyen sgrub g.yel ba mthol lo bshags/ /dam tshig ma dag spyod yul gcig pa sogs/ /mtho ris thar pa'i gegs su gyur pa dang / /'khor ba ngan song rgyur gyur sdig pa sogs/ /nyes pa ltung ba'i tshogs rnams ci mchis pa/

/de dag thams cad bla ma yi dam dang / /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems kyi/ /spyan sngar mi 'chab mi sbed mthol lo bshags/ /dus gsum dge ba kun la rjes yi rang / /rgya chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /mgon skyabs bral ba'i sems can thams cad la/ /tshad med thugs rje'i spyan gyis drag tu gzigs/ /rgya cher smon lam btab tshad 'grub par shog /pha ma'i thog drangs mkha' mnyam sems can la/ /las dang glo bur rkyen las gyur pa yis/ /nad gdon 'byung po'i 'tshe ba la sogs pa/ /'jig rten khams su 'byung bar ma gyur cig /yul phyogs thams cad bde zhing skyid par shog /dam chos tshul bzhin spyod pa'i skyes bu dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes chen rnams/ /zhabs pad brtan zhing 'phrin las rgyas gyur cig /mchog gsum bslu med rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag cag ngan song gsum dang sdig spyod kyis/ /rgyal por ma skyes mtho ris mi lus su/ /skyes ma thag tu dam chos tshul bzhin du/ /nyams su len zhing tshul khrims ldan par shog /'jig rten khams 'dir lo phyugs legs pa dang / /dus 'khrugs la sogs yid mi bde ba'i las/ /yul phyogs kun tu 'byung bar ma gyur cig /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi nad rims sdug bsngal sogs/ /lus can kun la 'tshe bar gyur pa yi/ /sdug bsngal mtha' dag myur du zhi gyur cig /bdag sogs ma gyur sems can thams cad kyang / /tshe ring nad med bde zhing skyid par shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam thugs rje dang / /chos bsrung dam can rgya mtsho'i nus mthu dang / /rgyu 'bras bslu med rnams kyi bden stobs kyis/ /smon lam ji ltar btab pa 'grub par shog /ces bshags pa smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni/ ri khud pa nyi ma dpon pos bshags pa smon lam go bde zhig kha ton la dgos tshul byung ba nas/ chos med snyoms las pa sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis kyis sbyar ba'o//
